restrictions: Rotation is a material degree of freedom, with the mouth fixed. Each order preparation is held homogeneous over the assay. The underlying carrier is prescribed.

The pooled and separate within-plane relative-angle constraints are distinct drives, not a decomposition into material mechanisms. Internal site measurements do not fix external contact or physical depth.

Bonded mean angle, triangular shear calibration and its order scaling, unit site drag and pinned outer radius are continuum trial data. Planar comparison holds edge modes only. Dimensional comparison is shell-only, locally homogeneous, independent of w, and supplies no actual bulk shear traction.
The material force is read from internal interactions, independently of the external layer-center constraint. No finite-mesh initial torque ratios are used as continuum material observables.
independent_local_review: Scoped clear for the conditional shell torque, finite-time bond-force comparison, cold relative-turn stiffness, and measured signs of shear-induced torque and turning at the thermal endpoints. The physical angular coupling to a free mouth remains unresolved.
